description: Orca lets you run a fleet of coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

latest_release.body:
## Smoother performance, easier dictation, saved phone drafts & clearer workspace controls ✨

Long chats stay more responsive while agents stream tool output, reasoning and subagent work, with less background processing during terminal and tab updates. This update also makes dictation easier to set up and use and makes agents and cloud workspaces easier to manage. Phone-specific improvements below require the matching phone app update.

- 🎙️ **Dictate with less setup:** Voice settings suggests an on-device model for your language and offers one setup button. Add personal or repository vocabulary, remove filler words, and use Auto mode to hold the shortcut or tap to toggle. On-device dictation inserts phrases as you pause, and you can dictate into fields in Orca's browser.
- 📱 **Pick up where you left off:** Chats show their saved recent messages after a phone relaunch while reconnecting. Commit messages, PR descriptions, comments, review notes, tasks and new-workspace drafts survive closing the app.
- ⌨️ **More control from your phone:** The terminal key row gains Shift, Ctrl and Alt latches and an optional Smart rail with agent actions. A floating dictation pill lets you keep speaking while moving to another screen in the app.
- 🤖 **Get agents ready from chat:** Supported missing agents offer installation and sign-in guidance where you start a chat. OpenCode subagents appear in their own cards and keep their chat active while they work; Codex replies can be forked after a rewind.
- 🧭 **Find the controls you need:** The browser groups its tools into an Annotate button and one menu. Settings is easier to scan, and recipe-backed VM workspaces show their lifecycle with Suspend and Resume actions.

## Highlights

- **Voice & dictation:** Speech-model updates are offered in the dictation pill when you start dictating, with download progress, cancellation and retry. Language-based setup suggestions, model quality information, a Use GPU switch, personal and repository vocabulary, and support for OpenAI-compatible transcription services. The dictation pill shows committed and pending words; failed recordings can be retried. Pressing Send or Enter while dictating waits for the words before sending.
- **Phone & recovery:** Saved chat messages and draft text return after a relaunch. Home opens with last-known workspaces, visited terminals stay mounted for quicker switching, and page assets load on demand. Folder workspaces have Source Control on the phone, and large-file diffs retain unchanged lines.
- **Chat & agents:** Copy and other reply actions stay visible on the latest response, while older replies reveal them on hover or keyboard focus. Account usage shows Used, Left and time until reset. Claude chat names use the CLI's titles, questions can show option previews, Codex failures give actionable advice, and a New divider is available in Settings. Usage-limited chats that are due can continue in one pass, with automatic retries stopping after five consecutive failures.
- **Workspaces & remote hosts:** Setup-script import understands more existing repository configurations. VM workspaces show creation progress and failures, and suspended VMs can be resumed from their workspace controls. Paired-server connection failures are detected when the host stops answering.
- **Browser, editor & everyday fixes:** Browser annotation, drawing and element capture share one control, with zoom and viewport state in the address field. Inline or side-by-side diff choice is saved. Linear search and issue lists include the project, and agent speed menus offer the speeds supported by the selected model.

**Dictation upgrade note:** Existing local speech-model downloads may need an update before dictation works again. Complete the download from the dictation pill or Voice settings before relying on dictation offline.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.255...v1.4.256

---

detail.readme:
Orca

中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español · Français · Português · Türkçe · Русский

The AI Orchestrator for 100x builders.
Run Claude Code, Codex, and any other coding agent in parallel, each in its own worktree. Chat or terminal, on your laptop or in the cloud, with diffs, a browser, and a CLI in one app.

Download Orca

## Features
### Chat or Terminal Run any agent in Chat UI or as the raw CLI, and move a conversation between the two without losing context. [Docs →](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/agents/native-chat)
### Orchestrate Agents Hand a big task to one agent. It splits the work, starts worker agents in their own workspaces, and brings their results back to you. [Docs →](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/cli/orchestration)
### Run Anywhere Pair a Remote Orca Server, work on any SSH host, or give a worktree its own cloud VM. Your agents keep running when your laptop sleeps. [Docs →](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/ways-to-run)
### Mobile App Pair Orca with the mobile app to get pinged when an agent needs you, reply in chat, and keep work moving on any of your machines when you are away from your desk. [iOS App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/orca-ide/id6766130217) · [Android APK](https://www.onorca.dev/download/android) · [Docs →](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/mobile)
### Review AI Output Review diffs, leave notes on exact changed lines, and send focused feedback back to an agent. [Docs →](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/review/annotate-ai-diff)
### Git Integration Draft commit messages and pull requests from the diff, then send failing checks or PR review comments back to an agent to fix. [Docs →](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/review/commit-push)
### Parallel Worktrees Quickly split tasks into isolated environments, so multiple agents can work side by side without interfering with each other. [Docs →](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/model/worktrees)
### Design Mode Click any element in Orca's browser to copy its HTML, styles, and selector, then paste it into your agent's chat. [Docs →](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/browser/design-mode)
### GitHub & Linear, Native See your GitHub and Linear tasks in one place, and start a workspace for each when you're ready to build. [Docs →](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/review/linear)
### Orca CLI Anything you can do in Orca, your agents can do too: create worktrees, start workers, drive the browser and desktop apps, and schedule automations, all from the command line. [Docs →](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/cli/overview)
### Plugins Themes, editors, languages, and panels from the community, installed in a click. [Browse plugins →](https://www.onorca.dev/plugins)
### Split Anything Put agents, terminals, browsers, and diffs side by side in split panes shaped to the task. [Docs →](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/model/tabs-panes-splits)
**Also in the box:** - **[Drag Files to Agents](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/editing/file-explorer)**: drag files from the explorer, or images from your desktop, straight into an agent's prompt. - **[Jump Anywhere](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/model/quick-open)**: one shortcut jumps to any workspace or tab across every repo and host. - **[Rich Previews](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/editing/viewers)**: open images, PDFs, and Markdown right in the workspace, next to the agent that made them. - **[Mobile Emulator](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/cli/overview#mobile-emulator)**: run an iOS Simulator or Android emulator beside your agent, and let it tap, type, and check its own work. - **[Dictation](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/settings#voice)**: press a shortcut and talk. Orca types what you say into the agent's prompt or terminal. - **[Usage & Accounts](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/agents/usage-tracking)**: see how much of your agent limits you've used and when they reset, and switch accounts without logging out. - **[Automations](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/cli/automations)**: schedule prompts to run on any repo: nightly dependency bumps, weekly triage, flaky-test sweeps. - **[Computer Use](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/cli/computer-use)**: when there's no CLI or API, agents can see and drive desktop apps and external browsers. - **And many, many more**: we ship daily, so this list is perpetually behind. The [changelog](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases) is the real feature list. --- ## Supported Agents Works with **any CLI agent** — if it runs in a terminal, it runs in Orca.

Claude Code   Codex   Grok   Cursor   GitHub Copilot   Muse   DeepSeek Harness   ZCode   OpenCode   MiMo Code   Amp   OpenClaude   Antigravity   Pi   oh-my-pi   Hermes Agent   Devin   Goose   Auggie   Autohand Code   Charm   Cline   CodeBuddy   Codebuff   Freebuff   Command Code   Continue   Droid   Kilocode   Kimi   Kiro   Mistral Vibe   Qwen Code   Rovo Dev   + any CLI agent

--- ## Install ### Desktop — macOS, Windows, Linux - **[Download from onOrca.dev](https://onorca.dev/download)** - Or grab a build directly: [macOS Apple Silicon](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest/download/orca-macos-arm64.dmg) · [macOS Intel](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest/download/orca-macos-x64.dmg) · [Windows (.exe)](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest/download/orca-windows-setup.exe) · [Linux AppImage](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest/download/orca-linux.AppImage) · [All builds](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest) _Or via a package manager:_ ```bash # macOS (Homebrew) # Always use the full name; bare `orca` is an unrelated Plotly cask. brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca # Upgrade an existing install brew upgrade --cask stablyai/orca/orca # Release candidates (conflicts with the stable cask; uninstall it first) brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca@rc # Arch Linux (AUR) — or stably-orca-git to build from source yay -S stably-orca-bin ``` ### Mobile App — iOS, Android Pair with your desktop app to monitor and steer your agents from your phone. - **iOS:** [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/orca-ide/id6766130217) - **Android:** [Download APK](https://www.onorca.dev/download/android) · [Install guide](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/android-apk) --- ## Community & Support - **Discord:** Join the community on **[Discord](https://discord.gg/fzjDKHxv8Q)**. - **Twitter / X:** Follow **[@orca_build](https://x.com/orca_build)** for updates and announcements. - **WeChat:** Scan to join an Orca community WeChat group. - **Feedback & Ideas:** We ship fast. Missing something? [Request a new feature](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/issues). - **Privacy:** See the [privacy & telemetry docs](https://www.onorca.dev/docs/telemetry) for what anonymous usage data Orca collects and how to opt out. - **Show Support:** [Star](https://github.com/stablyai/orca) this repo to follow along with our daily ships. --- ## Developing Want to contribute or run locally? See our [CONTRIBUTING.md](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.
